verdict.rationale: AFK claims to use scoped OAuth tokens with minimal permissions, automatic key rotation and audit logs (afk-docs-9). It also lets users set the autonomous-vs-supervised boundary, with reads automatic and writes paused for sign-off (afk-docs-7), and offers role-based access controls (afk-docs-10). However, this describes how AFK's own agent connects to integrations, not a way for users to issue scoped API credentials to an agent, and probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec (afk-probe-2). Missing for 10: user-facing credential/API-key issuance, configurable per-agent scopes, a documented public API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
